body_text:
If $f$ and $g$ are Riemann integrable on $[a,b]$ and
$\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb{R}$, then
$\int_a^b(\alpha f+\beta g)=\alpha\int_a^b f+
\beta\int_a^b g$. If $f\leq g$ pointwise, then
$\int_a^b f\leq\int_a^b g$. Consequently
$|\int_a^b f|\leq\int_a^b|f|$.
